serverInfo.name: Umbra Electric
serverInfo.description: Umbra Electric is a Seattle-based premium electric mobility retailer established in 2022, curating high-end electric dirt bikes, e-motos and e-bikes for adults and kids. Umbra Electric ships across the United States, Europe and worldwide, specializing in flagship off-road and trail machines from the brands that define the category. What sets Umbra apart is ruthless curation — only bikes worth owning.

resources.name: search-api
resources.description: Live JSON search over products and blog posts

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Umbra Electric catalog by keyword, category slug and/or maximum price. Returns matching products with slug, name, price, currency, category and URL.

query.description: Free-text search across product name, brand and description

category.description: Category slug to filter by, e.g. adult-electric-dirt-bikes

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for one product by slug: description, price, brand, category, warranty, images and FAQs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all product categories with slug, title, description and model count.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Get Umbra Electric's shipping, returns, payment and minimum-order policies.

tools.name: get_wholesale_info
tools.description: Get information on Umbra Electric's wholesale/dealer application process.

tools.name: create_order_draft
tools.description: Prepare a draft order summary with a pre-filled email order link (the primary, recommended way to complete it) and a WhatsApp link as a secondary option, for a human to review and complete. Never captures payment or personal data.

items.description: Products to include in the draft order

notes.description: Optional note to include in the order message

commerce.note: human_ordering_only — agents may search, inspect and prepare a draft order (create_order_draft); no payment or personal data is ever accepted from automated agents

legal.productType: Electric dirt bikes, e-motos and e-bikes
legal.compliance: Most electric dirt bikes are off-highway vehicles, not street-legal without registration, insurance and licensing where required.
